card.name: Aliquot and portion words
card.fires_on: The first part of "aliquot" ("aliqu") when a measured portion of liquid is divided, taken or added. It also fires on "helpings" meaning portions.

modes.label: Aliquot in procedures
modes.description: The start of "aliquot" in lab or dosing instructions about splitting a liquid into parts.

modes.description: The ending of "helpings" meaning servings of a substance.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning dose and portions, which fits predicting a measured amount.
card.plain: It notices when text talks about a measured portion of liquid, especially the word aliquot.
